screens.name: Sign In
screens.description: Allows any user to log in with username/email and password and reach the role-specific dashboard.

screens.name: Forgot Password
screens.description: Shows the instruction to contact the Administrator for a password reset (no self-service reset).

screens.name: Change Password
screens.description: Allows users to change their own password, including the mandatory change after receiving a temporary password.

screens.name: Profile
screens.description: Displays the current user's account, roles and branch/department; provides Change Password and Logout.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.description: Role-specific home page; for Operations Manager and Owner it shows room readiness, task workload, incident/maintenance and inventory indicators.

screens.name: Notification Center
screens.description: Lists notifications and alerts; search and filter by type, time, priority and read status.

screens.name: Notification Detail
screens.description: Displays a notification, marks it as read/acknowledged and opens the related record.

screens.name: User List
screens.description: Searches and filters user accounts; creates and activates/deactivates accounts.

screens.name: User Detail
screens.description: Displays and updates an account, resets its password, assigns branch/department and roles, and shows effective permissions.

screens.name: Role List
screens.description: Lists system roles and creates a new role.

screens.name: Role Detail
screens.description: Updates a role and configures its permissions by feature.

screens.name: Permission Matrix
screens.description: Displays the permissions of all roles in one matrix (read-only overview).

screens.name: Branch List
screens.description: Lists branches and creates a new branch.

screens.name: Branch Detail
screens.description: Displays, updates and deactivates a branch; shows its structure tree of floors, areas, rooms and departments.

screens.name: Floor/Area List
screens.description: Lists floors and areas of a branch and creates a new floor/area.

screens.name: Floor/Area Detail
screens.description: Displays, updates and deactivates a floor/area.

screens.name: Room Type List
screens.description: Lists room types of a branch and creates a new room type.

screens.name: Room Type Detail
screens.description: Displays, updates and deactivates a room type.

screens.name: Room List
screens.description: Searches and filters rooms by branch, floor, area, room type and status; creates a new room.

screens.name: Room Detail
screens.description: Displays room information, current status reason and status history; updates, deactivates or reactivates the room.

screens.name: Department List
screens.description: Lists departments of a branch and creates a new department.

screens.name: Department Detail
screens.description: Displays, updates and deactivates a department.

screens.name: Room Readiness Board
screens.description: Displays rooms by floor with operational status (Ready, Pending Cleaning, Cleaning, Pending Inspection, Rework, Blocked) and counts; opens next actions.

screens.description: Supervisor monitors tasks by status/overdue and cancels tasks; staff see their own cleaning tasks.

screens.description: Creates a cleaning task for a room with cleaning type, priority and due time.

screens.name: Cleaning Task Detail
screens.description: Displays a cleaning task; staff start it, update progress, report blockers and complete it.

screens.name: Cleaning Assignment
screens.description: Assigns or reassigns a cleaning task based on area and current workload.

screens.name: Rework Task List
screens.description: Lists rework tasks; staff see their own rework tasks.

screens.name: Rework Task Detail
screens.description: Displays defects to fix; staff accept, start and submit the rework with remediation notes.

screens.name: Room Turnover History
screens.description: Displays cleaning cycles of a room with assignees, times, inspection results and rework count.

screens.name: Inspection Checklist List
screens.description: Lists inspection checklists and creates a new checklist.

screens.name: Inspection Checklist Detail
screens.description: Edits criteria, manages versions, publishes or retires a checklist.

screens.name: Inspection Queue
screens.description: Lists rooms pending inspection/reinspection and failed inspections without rework; assigns the inspector.

screens.name: Room Inspection

screens.name: Inspection Result
screens.description: Displays the inspection summary and approves or rejects the room.

screens.name: Request Rework
screens.description: Creates a rework task from a failed inspection with defects, assignee and due time.

screens.name: Reinspection
screens.description: Records Fixed/Not Fixed for each defect of a submitted rework and concludes.

screens.name: Inspection History
screens.description: Searches inspections with results, defects, inspectors, housekeepers and checklist version.

screens.name: Incident List

screens.name: Report Incident
screens.description: Creates an incident with location/asset, description and evidence; shows similar open incidents.

screens.name: Incident Detail
screens.description: Classifies, triages, blocks room, escalates, verifies/closes or reopens an incident; adds evidence.

screens.name: Maintenance Assignment
screens.description: Assigns a technician and deadline to an incident.

screens.name: Maintenance Task List

screens.name: Maintenance Task Detail

screens.name: Preventive Maintenance Schedule List

screens.name: Preventive Maintenance Schedule Detail
screens.description: Updates a schedule and shows its executions and next due date.

screens.name: Reference Data

screens.name: Asset List
screens.description: Searches assets by branch, location, type and status; registers assets; shows statistics by location.

screens.name: Asset Detail
screens.description: Displays and updates an asset; assigns/transfers location, records handover, updates condition, retires it.

screens.name: Asset Maintenance History

screens.name: Warehouse List
screens.description: Lists warehouses and creates a new warehouse.

screens.name: Warehouse Detail
screens.description: Updates and deactivates a warehouse.

screens.name: Inventory Dashboard

screens.name: Item List

screens.name: Item Detail

screens.name: Unit of Measurement

screens.name: Stock Transaction List

screens.name: Stock Transaction Detail

screens.name: Stocktake List

screens.name: Replenishment List

screens.name: Task List

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Owner, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows an internal user to sign in with a provisioned account so that the system can identify the user and apply the user's roles and scope.
spec.Preconditions: The user has an internal account created by the Administrator (UC-004).
spec.Normal Flow:
Login
User opens the Login page.
System displays the Login form (username or email, password) and the Forgot Password link.
User enters the username or email and the password and selects Login.
System checks that both fields are filled (GBR-003).
System finds the account and verifies the password (GBR-019).
System checks that the account is Active and not locked (GBR-020).
System resets the failed-attempt counter, creates a session and calculates the effective permissions from the user's roles and scope (GBR-021, GBR-002).
System records the login in the audit log (GBR-008).
System opens the user's home page (notifications and the functions allowed for the user's roles).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Forgot Password
User selects Forgot Password and enters a username or email.
System displays the same instruction for every input, without revealing whether the account exists (MSG14, GBR-024).
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Missing Information
Username/email or password is empty.
System shows which field is required (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 5.1_Invalid Credentials
The account does not exist, the password is wrong, or the account is Inactive.
If the account exists, System increases its failed-attempt counter (GBR-020).
System displays the same generic message for all three cases (MSG11, GBR-019).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 5.2_Lock Threshold Reached
The failed attempt reaches SYS-PAR-01.
System sets locked_until = now + SYS-PAR-02 minutes (GBR-020).
System records the lock in the audit log (GBR-008).
System displays MSG11; the flow ends.
Step 6.1_Account Temporarily Locked
The password is correct but locked_until is later than now.
System does not create a session and displays the unlock time (MSG12, GBR-020).
The flow ends.
Step 7.1_Temporary Password
The password used is a valid temporary password.
System creates a restricted session that only allows changing the password (GBR-023).
System opens the Change Password screen (UC-003); the flow ends.
Step 7.2_Temporary Password Expired
The temporary password is older than SYS-PAR-05 hours.
System does not create a session (MSG13, GBR-023).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions:
Success: an active session exists and the user sees only functions granted by the user's roles and scope.
Failure: no session is created; failed attempts and locks are recorded.

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Owner, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows a signed-in user to end the current session.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Logout
User selects Logout from the user menu.
System revokes the current session (GBR-021).
System records the logout in the audit log (GBR-008).
System clears the client session and opens the Login page.
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Session Already Expired
The session is already expired or revoked.
System treats the logout as successful and opens the Login page.
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The session can no longer be used; any further request requires a new login.

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Owner, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows a user to change their own password, including the mandatory change after receiving a temporary password.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
For a forced change, the user is in a restricted session created from a temporary password (UC-001, Step 7.1).
spec.Normal Flow:
Change Password
User opens Change Password.
System displays fields: current password, new password, confirm new password, and the password policy.
User enters the three fields and selects Save.
System verifies the current password (GBR-019).
System checks that the new password matches the confirmation and satisfies the password policy (GBR-022).
System stores the new password hash, clears the temporary-password flag and revokes all other sessions of the user (GBR-021, GBR-023).
System records the change in the audit log without the password values (GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Wrong Current Password
The current password is incorrect.
System displays MSG03 for the current password field.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 5.1_Policy Not Met
The new password does not match the confirmation, violates the policy, or equals the current password.
System lists the unmet policy items (MSG03, GBR-022).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The new password is effective; other sessions are revoked; the restricted session (if any) becomes a normal session.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to create an internal account for a hotel employee and provision a temporary password.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create User Account
Administrator opens User Management and selects Create Account.
System displays the form: full name, username, email, phone, branch, department, role(s).
Administrator enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-003, GBR-025, GBR-031, GBR-004).
System creates the account as Active with the selected roles and scope (GBR-031).
System generates a random temporary password valid for SYS-PAR-05 hours (GBR-023).
System saves the account, role assignments and scope (without the password value) and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays the temporary password once so the Administrator can hand it to the employee (MSG15).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Duplicate Username or Email
The username or email already exists.
System shows the duplicated field (MSG35, GBR-025).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
Another field is invalid (e.g. the department does not belong to the branch).
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The account exists; the employee must change the temporary password at first login (UC-001, UC-003).

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to update an account's personal information and to reset a forgotten password.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The account exists in the Administrator's scope.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update User Account
Administrator searches for and opens the account.
System displays the account details with the current row version.
Administrator edits full name, email or phone and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-003, GBR-025, GBR-005).
System saves the changes and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Reset Password
The employee has forgotten the password and Administrator selects Reset Password after verifying the person.
System asks User to confirm the password reset of the account (MSG33).
System generates a new temporary password, marks the account for a forced change and revokes all sessions of the account (GBR-023, GBR-024).
System saves the reset event (without the password value) and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays the temporary password once (MSG15).
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Duplicate Email
The new email is used by another account.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.2_Role or Status Change Requested
Administrator tries to change roles or Active status here.
System informs that roles are changed in UC-010 and status in UC-006 (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Account information is updated; after a reset the employee must log in with the temporary password and change it.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to deactivate an account of an employee who leaves or must not use the system, or to reactivate it.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The account exists in the Administrator's scope.
spec.Normal Flow:
Activate/Deactivate User Account
Administrator opens the account and selects Deactivate (or Activate for an Inactive account).
System checks the dependencies: last Administrator, own account, open assigned work (GBR-026, GBR-027, GBR-028).
System asks User to confirm the status change of the account (MSG33).
Administrator enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-012, GBR-005).
System changes the status from Active to Inactive and revokes all of the account's sessions (GBR-021).
System saves the status change and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Open Work Exists
The account still has open assigned work.
System lists the open work items (MSG34).
Administrator asks the responsible lead to reassign them; the flow ends.
Step 2.2_Last Administrator or Own Account
The account is the last Administrator or the Administrator's own account.
System rejects the action (MSG03, GBR-026, GBR-027).
The flow ends.
Step 6.1_Reactivate Account
The account is Inactive and Administrator selected Activate.
System changes the status from Inactive to Active; an existing lock (locked_until) is kept until it expires.
Return to step 7 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Inactive accounts cannot log in; their history remains visible (GBR-009). Reactivated accounts can log in again.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to assign an account to branches and departments, and to change the assignment when the employee is transferred.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The account is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Assign User to Branch/Department
Administrator opens the account and selects Branch/Department Assignment.
System displays the current assignments and the active branches/departments.
Administrator adds or removes branch/department assignments and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-031, GBR-004, GBR-028, GBR-005).
System saves the new scope and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System recalculates the account's effective permissions at its next request (GBR-002).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Open Work in Removed Scope
The account has open assigned work in a branch/department being removed.
System lists the work items (MSG34, GBR-028).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The department does not belong to the branch or is inactive.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The account can only see and act on data in its new scope.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to create, rename and deactivate roles that group permissions.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create/Update User Role
Administrator opens Role Management.
System displays the roles with status and number of users.
Administrator selects Create Role (or an existing role), enters code, name and description and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-029, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the role and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Deactivate Role
Administrator selects Deactivate on a custom role.
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the role (MSG33).
System checks that deactivation does not remove the last Administrator permission set (GBR-026) and that the role is not a system role (GBR-029).
System changes the role from Active to Inactive; users keep their other roles (GBR-009).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The role code already exists.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The role is available (or no longer available) for assignment in UC-010. Renaming a role does not change its permissions.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to choose which catalog permissions a role grants.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The role is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Configure Role Permissions
Administrator opens a role and selects Permissions.
System displays the Permission Catalog grouped by feature, with the role's current grants (GBR-030).
Administrator selects or clears permissions and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-030, GBR-026, GBR-005).
System saves the role permissions with before/after lists and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System applies the new permissions to all users of the role at their next request (GBR-002).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Last Administrator Permissions
The change would remove permission administration from the last Administrator.
System rejects the change (MSG03, GBR-026).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The role's permissions are updated; scope and segregation-of-duty rules still apply.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to grant or revoke roles of an account.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The account is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Assign/Revoke User Roles
Administrator opens the account and selects Roles.
System displays the assigned roles and the active roles available.
Administrator adds or removes roles and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-004, GBR-026, GBR-027, GBR-018, GBR-005).
System saves the role assignments and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System recalculates the account's effective permissions (GBR-002).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Revocation Not Allowed
The revocation removes the last Administrator or the Administrator's own Administrator role.
System rejects the change (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.2_Executor Role Removed With Open Work
A removed role is needed for open work assigned to the account (e.g. Housekeeping Staff with open cleaning tasks).
System lists the open work (MSG34, GBR-028).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The account's effective permissions reflect the new role set.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to look up what a user can actually do: roles, scope and resulting permissions.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Review User Access Permissions
Administrator opens Access Review and selects an account.
System displays the account's roles, branches, departments and the effective permission list per feature (GBR-002).
Administrator optionally filters by feature or permission.
System shows, for each permission, which role grants it.
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to maintain branch information (name, address, contact, status) and to add a new branch.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Branch Information
Administrator opens Branch Management and selects a branch.
System displays the branch details with the current row version.
Administrator edits name, address, contact phone or email and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-032, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the branch and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Create Branch
Administrator selects Create Branch.
System displays an empty branch form; the timezone is fixed to SYS-PAR-10 (GBR-032).
Administrator enters code, name, address and contact and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-032, GBR-003).
System creates the branch as Active; return to Step 5.
Step 3.1_Deactivate Branch
Administrator selects Deactivate.
System checks dependencies (GBR-033); if any exist it lists them (MSG34) and the flow ends.
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the branch (MSG33).
System changes the branch from Active to Inactive; return to Step 5.
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The branch code already exists.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Branch data is up to date; inactive branches cannot be selected for new records.

spec.Primary Actors: Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head, Administrator, Owner
spec.Description: Allows users to view the structure of a branch: floors, areas, rooms and departments.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
View Branch Structure
User opens Branch Structure and selects a branch in scope.
System displays the branch with its floors and areas as a tree, the rooms of each floor, and the departments (GBR-015).
User expands a node or filters by active/inactive.
System displays the details of the selected node.
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to create a floor or an area (e.g. lobby, laundry, kitchen) in a branch.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Floor/Area
Administrator opens Branch Structure and selects Add Floor/Area.
System displays the form: branch, type (Floor or Area), code, name, parent floor (for an area), description.
Administrator enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-034, GBR-003, GBR-004).
System saves the floor/area as Active and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The code exists in the branch.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The parent is inactive, belongs to another branch, or creates a cycle.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The floor/area can be used for rooms, assets and incidents.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to edit a floor or area.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The floor/area exists and is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Floor/Area
Administrator opens the floor/area and selects Edit.
System displays its details with the current row version.
Administrator edits code, name, parent or description and enters a change reason, then selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-034, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the floor/area and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The code is duplicated or the new parent is in another branch or creates a cycle.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Rooms, assets and history keep referring to the same floor/area.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to deactivate a floor or area that is no longer used.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The floor/area is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Deactivate Floor/Area
Administrator opens the floor/area and selects Deactivate.
System checks for active rooms, child areas, assets and open incidents/tasks at the location (GBR-035).
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the floor/area (MSG33).
Administrator enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-012, GBR-005).
System changes the floor/area from Active to Inactive (GBR-009).
System saves the change and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Dependencies Exist
Active rooms, child areas, assets or open work exist.
System lists them (MSG34).
The flow ends; Administrator moves or deactivates them first.
spec.Postconditions: The floor/area cannot be selected for new records; history is kept.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to define a room type used for operations (cleaning standard and default inspection checklist).
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Room Type
Administrator opens Room Types and selects Create.
System displays the form: branch, code, name, description, standard cleaning minutes, default checklist.
Administrator enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-036, GBR-003, GBR-004).
System saves the room type as Active and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The code exists in the branch.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The room type can be assigned to rooms.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to update a room type.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The room type exists and is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Room Type
Administrator opens the room type and selects Edit.
System displays its details with the current row version.
Administrator edits name, description, standard cleaning minutes or default checklist and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-036, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the room type and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: New cleaning tasks and inspections use the updated defaults; past inspections keep the checklist version they used (GBR-057).

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to deactivate a room type that is no longer used.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The room type is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Deactivate Room Type
Administrator opens the room type and selects Deactivate.
System checks that no active room uses the room type (GBR-037).
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the room type (MSG33).
Administrator enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-012, GBR-005).
System changes the room type from Active to Inactive (GBR-009).
System saves the change and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Room Type In Use
Active rooms use the room type.
System lists the rooms (MSG34).
The flow ends; Administrator changes those rooms' type first (UC-021).
spec.Postconditions: The room type cannot be selected for rooms; history is kept.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to create a room so that it can be cleaned, inspected and tracked.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Room
Administrator opens Rooms and selects Create Room.
System displays the form: branch, floor, area (optional), room number, room type, notes.
Administrator enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-038, GBR-003, GBR-004).
System creates the room as active with operational status Pending Cleaning (GBR-039, GBR-043).
System saves the room and its first status history entry and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Duplicate Room Number
The room number exists in the branch.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The floor or room type is inactive or belongs to another branch.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The room appears on the room status board as Pending Cleaning; it becomes Ready only after a passed inspection.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to update a room's number, floor, area or room type.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The room exists and is active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Room Information
Administrator opens the room and selects Edit.
System displays its details with the current row version.
Administrator edits the fields, enters a change reason and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-038, GBR-003, GBR-004, GBR-005).
System saves the room (operational status, cleaning and inspection history are not changed) and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The room number is duplicated or the floor/type is invalid.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Room information is updated; open work keeps pointing to the same room.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to deactivate a room that is taken out of operation permanently.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The room is active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Deactivate Room
Administrator opens the room and selects Deactivate.
System checks for open cleaning, rework, inspection, incidents, effective blocks and assets in the room (GBR-040).
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the room (MSG33).
Administrator enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-012, GBR-005).
System marks the room inactive and recalculates its operational status to Inactive (GBR-043, GBR-044).
System saves the change and the status history entry and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Reactivate Room
The room is inactive and Administrator selects Activate.
System checks that its floor and room type are active (GBR-004).
System marks the room active and recalculates its status (Pending Cleaning until inspected) (GBR-039).
Return to step 7 of the normal flow.
Step 2.1_Open Work or Assets Exist
Dependencies exist.
System lists them (MSG34).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: Inactive rooms are excluded from the readiness denominator and cannot receive new work.

spec.Primary Actors: Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head, Administrator, Owner
spec.Description: Allows users to search the room list by branch, floor, room type and operational status.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
View Room Directory
User opens the Room Directory screen.
System displays rooms with number, floor, type and current operational status, sorted by floor then room number (GBR-015).
User filters by branch, floor, area, room type, operational status and active flag or searches by keyword.
System refreshes the list with matching records in the user's scope (GBR-015).
User selects a room.
System displays the room details, current status reason (source task/inspection/block) and links to its history.
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to create a department and link it to a branch and a Department Head.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Department
Administrator opens Departments and selects Create.
System displays the form: branch, code, name, description, Department Head (optional).
Administrator enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-041, GBR-003, GBR-004).
System saves the department as Active and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The code exists in the branch.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The selected Department Head is inactive or not assigned to the branch.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The department can receive users, warehouses, tasks and internal requests.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to update a department's name, description and Department Head.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The department is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Department
Administrator opens the department and selects Edit.
System displays the details with the current row version.
Administrator edits the fields and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-041, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the department and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: New approvals and requests for the department are routed to the current Department Head (GBR-111).

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to deactivate a department that no longer operates.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The department is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Deactivate Department
Administrator opens the department and selects Deactivate.
System checks for active users, warehouses, open tasks, open internal requests and assets in custody (GBR-042).
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the department (MSG33).
Administrator enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-012, GBR-005).
System changes the department from Active to Inactive (GBR-009).
System saves the change and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Dependencies Exist
Active users, warehouses, open work or assets exist.
System lists them (MSG34).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The department cannot be selected for new records; history is kept.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor and Operations Manager to monitor the operational status of all rooms, understand why a room is not Ready and act on it. Room status itself is calculated by the system from cleaning, inspection and incident records.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Manage Operational Room Status
User opens the Room Status Board.
System displays every room in scope grouped by floor, with its operational status (Ready, Pending Cleaning, Cleaning In Progress, Pending Inspection, Rework Required, Blocked, Inactive) calculated by the status priority (GBR-043, GBR-044).
User filters by floor, area, room type or status.
System refreshes the board and the count per status (GBR-015).
User selects a room.
System displays the status reason: the current cleaning task, inspection, rework task or effective blocks with their incidents, plus the room's status history.
User chooses the next action from the room panel: create a cleaning task (UC-028), assign an inspection (UC-041), report an incident (UC-049) or open the linked record.
System opens the selected function with the room preselected; the permission of that function is checked there (GBR-002).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
Step 6.1_View Status History
User selects Status History.
System lists the room's status changes with old/new status, source event, actor and time (GBR-043).
Return to step 7 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: No status is typed by the user; any action is completed in the selected use case and the board reflects it immediately.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to create a cleaning task for a room, with cleaning type, priority, instructions and due time.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Cleaning Task
Housekeeping Supervisor opens Cleaning Tasks and selects Create (or selects a room on the Room Status Board).
System displays the form: room, cleaning type (checkout, stay-over, deep cleaning), priority, due time, instructions and the room type's cleaning items.
Housekeeping Supervisor enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-003, GBR-004, GBR-045, GBR-014).
System creates the cleaning task with status Pending Assignment (GBR-045).
System recalculates the room status (Pending Cleaning unless Blocked) and stores the status history (GBR-043, GBR-044).
System saves the cleaning task and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Room Already Has an Open Cleaning Task
The room has a cleaning task that is not Completed or Cancelled.
System shows the existing task (MSG03, GBR-045).
Housekeeping Supervisor opens the existing task; the flow ends.
Step 4.2_Room Inactive
The room is inactive.
System rejects the creation (MSG24).
The flow ends.
Step 8.1_Assign Immediately
Housekeeping Supervisor selects Save and Assign.
System continues with UC-029 for the new task.
spec.Postconditions: The room has one open cleaning task waiting for assignment.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to assign a cleaning task to a housekeeper, taking the current workload into account.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The cleaning task is Pending Assignment.
spec.Normal Flow:
Assign Cleaning Task
Housekeeping Supervisor opens the cleaning task and selects Assign.
System lists eligible housekeepers on shift in the branch with their number of open cleaning tasks today (GBR-046).
Housekeeping Supervisor selects a housekeeper (and may adjust the due time) and selects Assign.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-046, GBR-014, GBR-005).
System sets the assignee and changes the task from Pending Assignment to Assigned.
System saves the assignment and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assigned housekeeper (UC-124) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The selected user is inactive, lacks the Housekeeping Staff role or is outside the branch/department.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 7.1_Notification Not Sent
The notification cannot be created.
System keeps the assignment, queues the notification for retry and displays MSG21 (GBR-010).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The task is Assigned and visible in the housekeeper's work list.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to move a cleaning task to another housekeeper when the current one cannot continue.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The cleaning task is Assigned, In Progress or On Hold.
spec.Normal Flow:
Reassign Cleaning Task
Housekeeping Supervisor opens the cleaning task and selects Reassign.
System displays the current assignee and eligible housekeepers with workload (GBR-046).
Housekeeping Supervisor selects the new housekeeper, enters the reason and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-047, GBR-046, GBR-012, GBR-005).
System closes the previous assignee's open work interval at the current time, if any (GBR-138).
System sets the new assignee and changes the task to Assigned (GBR-047).
System recalculates the room status (GBR-043).
System saves the reassignment with previous and new assignee and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the previous and the new assignee (UC-124) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The new assignee is the same person, ineligible, or the task is already Pending Inspection.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Only the new assignee can work on the task; time already worked stays with the previous assignee.

spec.Description: Allows the assigned housekeeper to start (or resume) cleaning a room; the system starts recording working time.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The cleaning task is Assigned or On Hold and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Start Cleaning Task
Housekeeping Staff opens My Work and selects the cleaning task.
System displays the room, cleaning type, instructions, cleaning items and due time.
Housekeeping Staff selects Start.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-049, GBR-136, GBR-137, GBR-005).
System changes the task to In Progress, sets the actual start time (first start only) and opens a work interval (GBR-138).
System recalculates the room status to Cleaning In Progress unless Blocked (GBR-043, GBR-044).
System saves the task, work interval and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Workday Not Started
User has no Working workday.
System displays MSG30 and offers to start the workday (UC-139).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow after the workday is started.
Step 4.2_Another Item In Progress
User has another open work interval.
System displays MSG31 with the open item (GBR-137).
The flow ends.
Step 4.3_Resume After Blocker
The task is On Hold.
Housekeeping Staff confirms that the blocker is resolved and enters a note.
System closes the blocker and continues at Step 5.
spec.Postconditions: The task is In Progress and the housekeeper's work time is being recorded.

spec.Description: Allows the housekeeper to tick cleaning items, add notes and photos, and update progress while cleaning.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The cleaning task is In Progress and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Cleaning Progress
Housekeeping Staff opens the cleaning task in progress.
System displays the cleaning items with their state, progress and notes.
Housekeeping Staff ticks completed items, updates progress, adds notes or photos and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-050, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System saves the progress and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Attachment
A file violates the attachment policy.
System rejects the file (MSG23, GBR-016).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
Progress is outside 0–100.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Progress is updated; the task is still In Progress (100% does not complete it).

spec.Description: Allows the housekeeper to report that cleaning cannot continue (guest still in room, broken equipment, missing supplies, unsafe condition).
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The cleaning task is In Progress and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Report Cleaning Blocker
Housekeeping Staff opens the cleaning task and selects Report Blocker.
System displays the blocker reasons (reference data) and fields for note and photo.
Housekeeping Staff selects the reason, enters a note, optionally attaches photos and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-051, GBR-003, GBR-016).
System records the blocker, changes the task from In Progress to On Hold and closes the open work interval (GBR-051, GBR-138).
System recalculates the room status (Pending Cleaning unless Blocked) (GBR-043).
System saves the blocker, task and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Housekeeping Supervisor (UC-126) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Equipment or Room Defect
The blocker is a broken fixture or equipment.
System offers to report an incident for the room (UC-049) with the blocker note prefilled.
After the incident is saved, System links it to the blocker; return to Step 4.
Step 3.2_Missing Supplies
The blocker is a lack of cleaning supplies or amenities.
System offers to create a material request (UC-091) linked to the cleaning task (UC-092).
Return to step 4 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Same Blocker Already Open
An open blocker with the same reason exists.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-051).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The task is On Hold with an open blocker; the housekeeper can start another room; the supervisor is informed.

spec.Description: Allows the housekeeper to confirm that cleaning is finished so the room goes to inspection.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The cleaning task is In Progress and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Complete Cleaning Task
Housekeeping Staff opens the cleaning task and selects Complete.
System displays the cleaning items, completion note and optional evidence photos.
Housekeeping Staff confirms all mandatory items, enters a note, optionally attaches photos and selects Complete.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-052, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System changes the task from In Progress to Pending Inspection, sets the actual end time and closes the work interval (GBR-052, GBR-138).
System recalculates the room status to Pending Inspection unless Blocked (GBR-043, GBR-044).
System saves the task, interval and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Housekeeping Supervisor so an inspection can be assigned (UC-041) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Mandatory Items Not Done
A mandatory item is not ticked or a blocker is open.
System lists the missing items (MSG03, GBR-052).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.2_Invalid Attachment
A file violates the attachment policy.
System displays MSG23.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The room waits for inspection; the housekeeper's time on the task is closed.

spec.Description: Allows the housekeeper to receive a rework task created after a failed inspection, see the defects to fix, accept it and start working.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
A rework task assigned to User exists in Pending Acceptance or Accepted.
spec.Normal Flow:
Receive Rework Task
Housekeeping Staff opens the rework task from My Work or the notification.
System displays the room, the failed inspection, the list of defects with photos and the due time.
Housekeeping Staff selects Accept.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-053, GBR-005).
System changes the rework task from Pending Acceptance to Accepted.
Housekeeping Staff selects Start when going to the room.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-053, GBR-136, GBR-137).
System changes the rework task to In Progress and opens a work interval (GBR-138).
System saves the rework task and interval and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 7.1_Workday Not Started or Busy
User has no Working workday or another open work interval.
System displays MSG30 or MSG31.
Return to step 6 of the normal flow after resolving it.
spec.Postconditions: The rework is In Progress; the room stays Rework Required until the rework is submitted.

spec.Description: Allows the housekeeper to submit the fixed defects so the room can be reinspected.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The rework task is In Progress and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Complete Cleaning Rework
Housekeeping Staff opens the rework task and selects Complete Rework.
System displays each defect with a remediation note field and optional photo.
Housekeeping Staff enters the remediation for each defect, optionally attaches photos and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-054, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System changes the rework task from In Progress to Pending Reinspection and closes the work interval (GBR-138).
System recalculates the room status to Pending Inspection unless Blocked (GBR-044).
System saves the rework results and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Housekeeping Supervisor for reinspection (UC-047) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Defect Without Remediation
A defect has no remediation note.
System highlights the defect (MSG03, GBR-054).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The room waits for reinspection.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to monitor cleaning and rework tasks (unassigned, in progress, on hold, waiting inspection, rework, overdue) and cancel tasks that are no longer needed.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Monitor Cleaning Tasks
User opens the Cleaning Monitor screen.
System displays today's cleaning and rework tasks with room, status, assignee, due time and overdue flag (GBR-055), sorted by due time (GBR-015).
User filters by date, floor, status, assignee, priority and overdue flag or searches by keyword.
System refreshes the list with matching records in the user's scope (GBR-015).
User selects a task to view its details, blocker, timeline and links to assign (UC-029) or reassign (UC-030).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
Step 5.1_Cancel Cleaning Task
The task is no longer needed (e.g. the room is not checked out) and Housekeeping Supervisor selects Cancel.
System checks that the task is Pending Assignment or Assigned (GBR-048).
System asks User to confirm the cancellation of the cleaning task (MSG33).
Housekeeping Supervisor enters the reason and confirms (GBR-012).
System changes the task to Cancelled and recalculates the room status from the latest non-cancelled cycle (GBR-044).
System saves the cancellation and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assignee, if any (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
Step 5.2_Cancellation Not Allowed
The task has already started.
System displays MSG24; Housekeeping Supervisor may reassign it instead (UC-030).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The supervisor sees the current workload; cancelled tasks remain in history.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to view the turnover history of a room: each cleaning cycle with housekeeper, times, inspection results and rework count.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
View Room Turnover History
User opens a room and selects Turnover History (or opens Turnover History and selects a room).
System lists the room's cleaning cycles, newest first: cleaning type, assignee(s), start/end times, inspection result, number of rework rounds, cancellation reason if any (GBR-015).
User filters by date range or result.
User selects a cycle.
System displays the cycle timeline: cleaning task, blockers, inspections with checklist version and defects, rework tasks and attachments (GBR-016).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to create an inspection checklist (criteria, mandatory flags, pass conditions) and publish it for a room type.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Room Inspection Checklist
Housekeeping Supervisor opens Inspection Checklists and selects Create.
System displays the form: name, applicable room types, and a criteria list (text, group, mandatory flag).
Housekeeping Supervisor enters the criteria and selects Save as Draft.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-056, GBR-003).
System saves the checklist as version 1 in Draft and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
Housekeeping Supervisor reviews it and selects Publish.
System changes the version from Draft to Published (GBR-056).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The checklist has no criterion or a criterion has no text.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The published checklist can be used for inspections of the selected room types.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to change checklist criteria while keeping completed inspections unchanged.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The checklist exists.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Room Inspection Checklist
Housekeeping Supervisor opens the checklist and selects Edit.
System displays the current version and whether it has been used by an inspection (GBR-057).
Housekeeping Supervisor changes criteria and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-056, GBR-057, GBR-005).
System saves the changes into the Draft version, or creates a new Draft version if the current version is Published (GBR-057).
Housekeeping Supervisor selects Publish.
System publishes the new version and retires the previous one; inspections already assigned keep their version.
System saves the checklist versions and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Retire Checklist
Housekeeping Supervisor selects Retire.
System asks User to confirm the retirement of the checklist (MSG33).
System changes the published version to Retired; it can no longer be used for new inspections.
Return to step 8 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: New inspections use the latest published version; history shows the version actually used.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to assign an inspector to a room whose cleaning or rework has been submitted.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The room's cleaning task is Pending Inspection (or its rework task is Pending Reinspection for UC-047).
spec.Normal Flow:
Assign Room Inspection
Housekeeping Supervisor opens Pending Inspections (or selects the room on the board) and selects Assign Inspection.
System displays the room, the cleaning cycle, the published checklist of the room type and eligible inspectors (GBR-058).
Housekeeping Supervisor selects the inspector (can be themself) and the due time, and selects Assign.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-058, GBR-059, GBR-056, GBR-014).
System creates the inspection with status Assigned, linked to the cleaning cycle and the checklist version.
System saves the inspection and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the inspector (UC-124) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Inspector Performed the Cleaning
The selected inspector cleaned the room in this cycle.
System rejects the selection (MSG22, GBR-059).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.2_Open Inspection Exists
The cycle already has an open inspection.
System shows it (MSG03); Housekeeping Supervisor may change its inspector instead.
The flow ends.
Step 4.3_No Published Checklist
The room type has no published checklist.
System displays MSG03 and asks to publish a checklist (UC-039).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: One inspection is assigned for the cleaning cycle.

spec.Description: Allows the assigned inspector to inspect the room against the checklist and record Pass/Fail for each criterion.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The inspection is Assigned or Inspecting and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Perform Room Inspection
Inspector opens the inspection and selects Start.
System changes the inspection from Assigned to Inspecting and displays the checklist criteria.
Inspector records Pass or Fail for each criterion, with notes and photos as needed.
For each failed criterion, Inspector records the defects (UC-043).
Inspector selects Finish Inspection.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-060, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System changes the inspection from Inspecting to Pending Conclusion and shows the summary (passed/failed criteria, defects).
System saves the results and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
Inspector concludes with Approve (UC-044) or Reject (UC-045).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Save and Continue Later
Inspector selects Save Draft.
System saves the results entered so far; the inspection stays Inspecting.
The flow ends.
Step 6.1_Results Incomplete
A mandatory criterion has no result or a failed criterion has no defect.
System lists the missing items (MSG03, GBR-060).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The inspection is Pending Conclusion with complete results.

spec.Description: Allows the inspector to record defects found during inspection with description, severity and photos.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The inspection is Inspecting or Pending Conclusion and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Record Inspection Defects
Inspector selects a failed criterion and selects Add Defect.
System displays the defect form: description, severity (minor/major), location in room, photos.
Inspector enters the defect and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-061, GBR-003, GBR-016).
System saves the defect linked to the criterion and inspection and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Inspection Already Concluded
The inspection is Passed or Failed.
System displays MSG24 (GBR-061).
The flow ends.
Step 4.2_Invalid Attachment
A photo violates the attachment policy.
System displays MSG23.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Defects are attached to the inspection and will be used for the rework task.

spec.Description: Allows the inspector to approve a room that meets all mandatory criteria, completing the cleaning cycle and making the room Ready if it is not blocked.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The inspection is Pending Conclusion and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Approve Room Inspection
Inspector reviews the summary and selects Approve.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-062, GBR-059, GBR-005).
System changes the inspection from Pending Conclusion to Passed.
System changes the cleaning task from Pending Inspection to Completed (GBR-062).
System recalculates the room status: Ready if no effective block exists (GBR-043, GBR-044).
System saves the inspection, cleaning task and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the housekeeper who cleaned the room (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Mandatory Criterion Failed
At least one mandatory criterion is Fail.
System rejects approval (MSG03, GBR-062) and offers Reject (UC-045).
The flow ends.
Step 5.1_Room Still Blocked
The room has an effective block.
System keeps the room Blocked and displays MSG17.
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The cleaning cycle is Completed; the room is Ready unless blocked.

spec.Description: Allows the inspector to reject a room that does not meet the checklist, so rework is required.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The inspection is Pending Conclusion and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Reject Room Inspection
Inspector reviews the summary and selects Reject.
System displays the failed criteria and defects and a field for the overall reason.
Inspector enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-063, GBR-060, GBR-012, GBR-005).
System changes the inspection from Pending Conclusion to Failed.
System changes the cleaning task from Pending Inspection to Rework Required (GBR-063).
System recalculates the room status to Rework Required unless Blocked (GBR-044).
System saves the inspection, cleaning task and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Housekeeping Supervisor and the housekeeper who cleaned the room (UC-126) (GBR-010).
System opens Request Cleaning Rework (UC-046) with the defects preselected.
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Defect Recorded
The failed inspection has no defect.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-060).
Return to step 2 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The room is Rework Required; a rework task must be created.

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to send the defects of a failed inspection back as a rework task to a housekeeper.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The inspection is Failed and has no open rework task.
spec.Normal Flow:
Request Cleaning Rework
Housekeeping Supervisor opens the failed inspection and selects Request Rework.
System displays the defects (all preselected), eligible housekeepers (the original cleaner first) and a due time field.
Housekeeping Supervisor selects the defects, assignee and due time and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-064, GBR-046, GBR-014).
System creates the rework task with status Pending Acceptance, linked to the inspection and the selected defects.
System saves the rework task and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assignee (UC-124) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Open Rework Exists
The inspection already has an open rework task.
System shows it (MSG03, GBR-064).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The rework task waits for the housekeeper's acceptance (UC-035).

spec.Description: Allows the Housekeeping Supervisor to reinspect the defects of a submitted rework task and conclude the cleaning cycle.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The rework task is Pending Reinspection; the reinspection is assigned to User (UC-041).
spec.Normal Flow:
Reinspect Room
Inspector opens the reinspection.
System displays each defect of the rework task with the remediation note and photos, and the link to the original inspection (GBR-065).
Inspector records Fixed or Not Fixed for every defect, with notes and photos, and selects Conclude.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-065, GBR-059, GBR-016, GBR-005).
All defects are Fixed: System sets the reinspection Passed, the rework task Completed and the cleaning task Completed (GBR-065).
System recalculates the room status (Ready unless Blocked) (GBR-044).
System saves the reinspection, rework task, cleaning task and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the housekeeper (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Not All Defects Checked
A defect has no result.
System displays MSG03.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 5.1_Defects Not Fixed
At least one defect is Not Fixed.
System sets the reinspection Failed and the rework task Failed; the cleaning task stays Rework Required (GBR-065).
System records new defects for the items not fixed.
System saves the results and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System opens Request Cleaning Rework (UC-046) for the remaining defects; the flow ends.
Step 6.1_Room Still Blocked
The room has an effective block.
System keeps the room Blocked and displays MSG17.
Return to step 7 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The cycle is Completed, or a new rework round is started.

spec.Description: Allows users to look up inspection history: results, failed criteria, defects, inspectors, housekeepers and evidence.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
View Room Inspection History
User opens the Inspection History screen.
System displays inspections with room, date, inspector, checklist version, result and rework rounds, sorted by inspection date (newest first) (GBR-015).
User filters by branch, room, date range, result, inspector and housekeeper or searches by keyword.
System refreshes the list with matching records in the user's scope (GBR-015).
User selects an inspection.
System displays all criteria results, defects with photos, rework tasks and reinspections, and the checklist version used (GBR-057, GBR-016).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows any operational user to report a fault or service incident with its location, description, discovery time and evidence.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Report Incident
User opens Report Incident (or selects Report Incident from a room, asset or cleaning blocker).
System displays the form: branch, room/area, asset (optional), title, description, detected time, photos.
User enters the information and selects Next.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-066, GBR-003, GBR-016, GBR-014).
System searches open incidents at the same room/area/asset and shows them if any (GBR-067).
User confirms creating a new incident.
System creates the incident with status Pending Triage and stores the attachments.
System saves the incident and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Maintenance Lead of the branch (UC-126) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Attachment
A file violates the attachment policy.
System displays MSG23.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
No room, area or asset is selected, or the asset is in another branch.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 5.1_Add to Existing Incident
A similar open incident exists and User selects it.
System displays MSG32 and continues with UC-051 for the selected incident.
The flow ends without creating a new incident.
spec.Postconditions: The incident waits for classification and triage by the Maintenance Lead.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to classify an incident by technical category, severity and impact on room readiness.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is not Closed or Cancelled.
spec.Normal Flow:
Classify Incident
Maintenance Lead opens the incident and selects Classify.
System displays category (reference data), severity (Low, Normal, High, Critical) and the 'affects room readiness' flag.
Maintenance Lead selects the values and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-068, GBR-004, GBR-005).
System saves the classification and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 5.1_Critical Severity
Severity is Critical.
System creates Critical incident alerts for the Maintenance Lead and Operations Manager that require acknowledgment (UC-126, GBR-068, GBR-159).
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
Step 5.2_Affects Room Readiness
The flag is set and the incident has a room.
System suggests blocking the room (UC-056).
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The incident is classified and ready for triage.

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows users involved in an incident to add photos, documents or notes that clarify it.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is not Closed or Cancelled.
User is the reporter, the assignee, a Maintenance Lead or an Operations Manager in scope.
spec.Normal Flow:
Attach Incident Evidence
User opens the incident and selects Add Evidence.
System displays fields for a note and files.
User enters a note and/or selects files and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-016, GBR-003).
System saves the evidence linked to the incident with author and time and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Incident Closed
The incident is Closed or Cancelled.
System displays MSG24; evidence can only be viewed.
The flow ends.
Step 4.2_Invalid File
A file violates the attachment policy.
System displays MSG23.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The evidence is visible to everyone who can view the incident.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to triage a new incident: set priority, response and resolution deadlines and the initial action plan, or cancel it as duplicate/invalid.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is Pending Triage and has category and severity (UC-050).
spec.Normal Flow:
Triage Incident
Maintenance Lead opens the incident and selects Triage.
System displays priority options and calculates default response and resolution deadlines from the detected time and the SLA targets of each priority (GBR-069).
Maintenance Lead selects the priority, reviews the deadlines and enters the initial action plan, then selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-069, GBR-014, GBR-005).
System changes the incident from Pending Triage to Pending Assignment.
System saves the triage and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System opens Assign Maintenance Work (UC-053).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Deadline Changed
Maintenance Lead changes a default deadline.
System requires a reason and stores the default and chosen deadline (GBR-069, GBR-012).
Return to step 4 of the normal flow.
Step 3.2_Duplicate or Invalid Incident
Maintenance Lead selects Cancel as Duplicate/Invalid.
System requires the original incident (for Duplicate) and a reason (GBR-070).
System asks User to confirm the cancellation of the incident (MSG33).
System changes the incident to Cancelled and removes its effective blocks, recalculating room status (GBR-075, GBR-043).
System saves the cancellation and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the reporter (GBR-010).
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Not Classified
Category or severity is missing.
System displays MSG03 and opens UC-050.
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The incident has a priority and SLA deadlines and waits for assignment.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to assign (or reassign) a technician and the expected completion time.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is Pending Assignment or Assigned.
spec.Normal Flow:
Assign Maintenance Work
Maintenance Lead opens the incident and selects Assign.
System lists eligible technicians in the branch with their open incidents and occurrences (GBR-071).
Maintenance Lead selects the technician (themself only if another active Maintenance Lead of the branch can verify), instructions and planned end time, then selects Assign.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-071, GBR-014, GBR-005).
System sets the assignee and changes the incident to Assigned.
System saves the assignment with previous and new assignee and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the technician (and the previous assignee when reassigning) (UC-124) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The selected user is inactive or not Maintenance Staff/Maintenance Lead of the branch.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The incident is Assigned and appears in the technician's work list.

spec.Description: Allows the assigned technician to accept the maintenance work and start it; the acceptance time is the response time.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is Assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Accept and Start Maintenance
Technician opens the incident from My Work or the notification.
System displays the incident, location, evidence, priority and deadlines.
