Technician selects Accept and Start.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-072, GBR-136, GBR-137, GBR-005).
System records the acceptance time, changes the incident from Assigned to In Progress and opens a work interval (GBR-138).
System saves the incident and interval and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Cannot Take the Work
Technician selects Decline with a reason.
System returns the incident to Pending Assignment and notifies the Maintenance Lead (GBR-012).
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Workday Not Started or Busy
User has no Working workday or another open work interval.
System displays MSG30 or MSG31.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow after resolving it.
spec.Postconditions: The incident is In Progress; the response time is fixed.

spec.Description: Allows the technician to record diagnosis, actions, progress and materials used, and to put the work on hold or resume it.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is In Progress or On Hold and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Maintenance Progress
Technician opens the incident and selects Update Progress.
System displays progress, diagnosis, actions taken, materials issued for this incident and attachments.
Technician enters progress, notes and materials used and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-050, GBR-074, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System saves the progress update and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Put On Hold
Work must stop (waiting for materials, vendor or guest).
Technician selects Hold, the hold reason and a note.
System changes the incident from In Progress to On Hold and closes the work interval (GBR-073, GBR-138).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 3.2_Resume Work
The incident is On Hold and Technician selects Resume.
System checks the workday and open intervals (GBR-136, GBR-137).
System changes the incident to In Progress and opens a work interval.
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 3.3_Materials Needed
Technician needs materials.
System opens Create Material Request (UC-091) linked to the incident (UC-092).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Materials Exceed Issued Quantity
Used quantity is higher than the issued, not returned quantity.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-074).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Progress and material usage are recorded; SLA time continues during On Hold.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to block a room affected by an incident so that it cannot become Ready, and to remove the block early when the room is usable.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is not Closed or Cancelled and has a room in its affected scope.
spec.Normal Flow:
Block Room Due to Incident
Maintenance Lead opens the incident and selects Block Room.
System displays the rooms in the incident's scope and their current status.
Maintenance Lead selects the room(s), enters the reason and selects Block.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-075, GBR-012, GBR-004).
System creates an effective block per incident–room pair and recalculates each room's status to Blocked (GBR-075, GBR-044).
System saves the blocks and room status history and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Housekeeping Supervisor of the branch (UC-126) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Remove Block Early
The room can be used before the incident is closed; Maintenance Lead selects Remove Block.
System asks User to confirm the removal of the block (MSG33).
Maintenance Lead enters the reason (GBR-012).
System changes the block from Effective to Removed and recalculates the room status (GBR-075).
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Block Already Exists
The incident already blocks the room.
System displays MSG03.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The room is Blocked until all its effective blocks are removed.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to escalate a critical, at-risk or overdue incident to the Operations Manager for extra resources or decisions.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is not Closed or Cancelled.
spec.Normal Flow:
Escalate Critical Incident
Maintenance Lead opens the incident and selects Escalate.
System shows the severity, deadlines and time used against the at-risk threshold (GBR-076).
Maintenance Lead enters the escalation reason and requested support and selects Escalate.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-076, GBR-012).
System creates an Open escalation linked to the incident.
System saves the escalation and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Operations Manager; the alert requires acknowledgment (UC-126, UC-130) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Not Eligible or Already Escalated
The incident is not critical/at-risk/overdue, or an Open escalation exists.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-076).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The Operations Manager is informed; the escalation closes automatically when the incident is closed or cancelled.

spec.Description: Allows the assigned technician to submit the repair result for verification.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is In Progress and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Resolve Maintenance Incident
Technician opens the incident and selects Submit Result.
System displays fields: diagnosis/root cause, action taken, materials used, actual end time (server time), result photos.
Technician enters the result and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-077, GBR-074, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System changes the incident from In Progress to Pending Verification and closes the work interval (GBR-138).
System saves the result and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Maintenance Lead of the branch who did not perform the work (verifier) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
A mandatory result field is missing or materials exceed the issued quantity.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The incident waits for verification; the resolution time is recorded.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to check the repair result and close the incident, removing its room blocks, or return it for more work.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is Pending Verification.
spec.Normal Flow:
Verify and Close Incident
Verifier opens the incident and selects Verify.
System displays the submitted result, evidence, materials and deadlines.
Verifier selects Accept and Close and enters a verification note.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-078, GBR-013, GBR-005).
System changes the incident from Pending Verification to Closed and closes its Open escalation.
System removes all effective blocks of the incident and recalculates the status of each affected room (GBR-075, GBR-044).
System saves the closure, blocks and room status and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the reporter, the technician and the Housekeeping Supervisor if a room was unblocked (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Return for More Work
The result is not acceptable.
Verifier selects Return and enters the reason (GBR-012).
System changes the incident from Pending Verification to In Progress; blocks stay effective (GBR-078).
System saves the return and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the technician (GBR-010).
System displays MSG20; the flow ends.
Step 4.1_Verifier Did the Work
The verifier submitted or performed the result.
System displays MSG22 (GBR-013, GBR-078).
The flow ends.
Step 8.1_Linked Asset
The incident is linked to an asset in Damaged or Under Repair condition.
System notifies the Operations Manager to update the asset condition (UC-070).
Return to step 9 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The incident is Closed and rooms without other blocks can become Ready, or it is back In Progress.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to reopen a closed incident when the problem returns, keeping the previous handling history.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The incident is Closed.
spec.Normal Flow:
Reopen Incident
Maintenance Lead opens the incident and selects Reopen.
System displays the closure details and reopen window (GBR-079).
Maintenance Lead enters the reason and evidence of recurrence and selects Reopen.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-079, GBR-012, GBR-016).
System starts a new processing cycle: the incident changes from Closed to Pending Triage; previous cycle data is kept.
System saves the reopening and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the previous technician (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Reopen Window Expired
The incident was closed more than SYS-PAR-19 days ago.
System displays MSG03 and suggests reporting a new incident (UC-049).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The incident goes through triage, assignment and verification again.

spec.Description: Allows the Maintenance Lead to create a preventive maintenance schedule for an asset, room or area, and to edit or deactivate it later.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Preventive Maintenance Schedule
Maintenance Lead opens Preventive Maintenance and selects Create Schedule.
System displays the form: target (asset/room/area), title, work description and check items, interval (number + days/weeks/months), first due date, default assignee.
Maintenance Lead enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-081, GBR-003, GBR-004, GBR-014).
System saves the schedule as Active with next due date = first due date and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Edit Schedule
Maintenance Lead opens an Active schedule and selects Edit.
System displays the schedule with the current row version.
Maintenance Lead changes description, check items, interval or default assignee and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-081, GBR-082, GBR-005).
System applies the change to future occurrences only; return to Step 5.
Step 1.2_Deactivate Schedule
Maintenance Lead selects Deactivate.
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the schedule (MSG33).
Maintenance Lead enters the reason (GBR-012).
System changes the schedule to Inactive; occurrences already generated remain (GBR-082).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Duplicate Schedule
The target already has an Active schedule with the same title.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The system generates occurrences automatically before each due date (GBR-083).

spec.Description: Allows the technician to carry out a generated preventive maintenance occurrence, record the check results and complete it.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
A maintenance occurrence is Assigned to User (generated by the system, GBR-083).
spec.Normal Flow:
Execute Scheduled Maintenance
Technician opens the occurrence from My Work.
System displays the target, check items, due date and history of the previous occurrence.
Technician selects Start.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-084, GBR-136, GBR-137).
System changes the occurrence from Assigned to In Progress and opens a work interval (GBR-138).
Technician records a result for every check item, notes and photos, and selects Complete.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-084, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System changes the occurrence to Completed, closes the work interval and sets the schedule's next due date from the scheduled due date (GBR-083).
System saves the occurrence, interval and schedule and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Assign or Cancel Occurrence
Maintenance Lead opens a Pending Assignment or Assigned occurrence.
Maintenance Lead selects a technician, or selects Cancel with a reason (GBR-012).
System sets it Assigned (notifying the technician) or Cancelled.
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Workday Not Started or Busy
User has no Working workday or another open interval.
System displays MSG30 or MSG31.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 6.1_Problem Found
A check item fails.
Technician selects Report Incident; System opens UC-049 prefilled with the target and links the incident to the occurrence (GBR-084).
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The occurrence is Completed and the next one is planned.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to manage task categories used by operational tasks and work statistics (e.g. cleaning support, maintenance, inventory, front-office support).
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Manage Work Categories
Administrator opens Work Categories.
System lists categories with code, name, status and usage count.
Administrator creates or edits a category (code, name, description) and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-085, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the category and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Deactivate Category
Administrator selects Deactivate.
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the category (MSG33).
System sets the category Inactive; existing tasks keep it (GBR-085, GBR-009).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The code exists.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Active categories can be selected for new tasks.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to manage shared reference data: incident categories, blocker and pause reasons, cleaning types, internal request types, priority labels and the SLA targets of each priority.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Manage Operational Reference Data
Administrator opens Reference Data and selects a group.
System lists the values of the group with code, label, order and status (for priorities: response and resolution targets in minutes).
Administrator creates or edits a value and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-085, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the value and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Deactivate Value
Administrator selects Deactivate.
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the value (MSG33).
System sets it Inactive; history keeps its meaning (GBR-085).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Fixed Priority Code
Administrator tries to add, rename the code of, or deactivate a priority.
System displays MSG03; only labels and SLA targets of LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, CRITICAL can change (GBR-085).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: New SLA targets apply to incidents triaged afterwards; existing deadlines are unchanged.

spec.Description: Allows the Operations Manager to register an asset or equipment item with its identification and managing branch.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Register Asset/Equipment
Operations Manager opens Assets and selects Register.
System displays the form: branch, asset code, name, category, brand/model, serial number, purchase date, warranty end, custodian department, notes, photos.
Operations Manager enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-086, GBR-003, GBR-004, GBR-016).
System saves the asset as Active, condition In Use, without location and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System opens Assign Asset to Location (UC-067).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The asset code exists.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The asset is registered; it is counted at a location after UC-067.

spec.Description: Allows the Operations Manager to edit an asset's identification and description.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The asset is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Asset Information
Operations Manager opens the asset and selects Edit.
System displays its details with the current row version; location, custodian and condition are read-only (GBR-087).
Operations Manager edits the fields and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-086, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the asset and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Asset information is updated; location changes use UC-068 and custody changes use UC-069.

spec.Description: Allows the Operations Manager to place a newly registered asset at its first location.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The asset is Active and has no current location.
spec.Normal Flow:
Assign Asset to Location
Operations Manager opens the asset and selects Assign Location.
System displays rooms and areas of the asset's branch.
Operations Manager selects the room or area and the effective date and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-086, GBR-004, GBR-005).
System sets the current location and creates the first movement record (GBR-087).
System saves the location and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The location is inactive or in another branch.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The asset is counted at its location.

spec.Description: Allows the Operations Manager to move an asset between rooms, areas or branches with a movement record.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The asset is Active and has a current location.
spec.Normal Flow:
Transfer Asset Location
Operations Manager opens the asset and selects Transfer Location.
System displays the current location and the target options (rooms/areas in branches within the manager's scope).
Operations Manager selects the new location, enters the reason and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-087, GBR-004, GBR-012, GBR-005).
System updates the current location and creates a movement record with old and new location (GBR-087).
System saves the movement and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Same Location
The target equals the current location.
System displays MSG03.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.2_Open Incident or Occurrence
The asset has an open incident or maintenance occurrence.
System warns and requires a confirmation note (GBR-087).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The asset appears at its new location; movements are listed in its profile.

spec.Description: Allows the custodian department to hand over custody of an asset to another department; the receiving Department Head acknowledges or rejects it.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The asset is Active and in the sender's custody (sender's department, or any department for the Operations Manager).
No pending handover exists for the asset.
spec.Normal Flow:
Record Asset Handover
Sender opens the asset and selects Hand Over.
System displays the current custodian, condition and the receiving department options.
Sender selects the receiving department, records the condition at handover, notes and photos, and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-088, GBR-004, GBR-016).
System creates the handover as Pending Acknowledgment; custody does not change yet (GBR-088).
System saves the handover and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the receiving Department Head (GBR-010).
Receiving Department Head opens the handover, checks the asset and selects Acknowledge.
System changes the handover to Acknowledged and sets the receiving department as custodian (GBR-088).
System saves the acknowledgment and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the sender (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 8.1_Reject Handover
The receiver disagrees (e.g. condition differs).
Receiver selects Reject and enters the reason (GBR-012).
System changes the handover to Rejected; custody stays with the sender.
System saves the rejection and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the sender (GBR-010).
System displays MSG19; the flow ends.
Step 8.2_Resubmit
The handover was Rejected and the sender selects Resubmit.
System creates a new version of the handover in Pending Acknowledgment, keeping the rejected version (GBR-088).
Return to step 7 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Custody changes only after acknowledgment; the full handover history is kept.

spec.Description: Allows authorized users to update an asset's condition (In Use, Damaged, Under Repair).
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The asset is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Asset Condition
User opens the asset and selects Update Condition.
System displays the current condition and linked open incidents.
User selects the new condition, enters a note and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-089, GBR-005).
System saves the condition change and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Damaged Without Incident
User sets Damaged and there is no open incident for the asset.
System offers to report an incident (UC-049).
Return to step 4 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Back to In Use With Open Incident
Linked incidents are not closed.
System requires a reason (GBR-089, GBR-012).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The asset condition is visible in its profile and statistics. Retirement uses UC-074.

spec.Primary Actors: Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head, Owner
spec.Description: Allows users to view an asset's profile: identification, current location, custodian, condition, documents and recent activity.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
View Asset Profile
User opens the Assets screen.
System displays assets with code, name, location, custodian and condition, sorted by asset code (GBR-015).
User filters by branch, category, location, custodian department, condition and lifecycle status or searches by keyword.
System refreshes the list with matching records in the user's scope (GBR-015).
User selects an asset.
System displays the profile with movements, handovers, open incidents and schedules; files are shown only if User may view the source record (GBR-016).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows users to review the maintenance history of an asset: incidents, repairs, materials and preventive occurrences.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Review Asset Maintenance History
User opens an asset and selects Maintenance History.
System lists incidents and preventive occurrences of the asset, newest first, with dates, technicians, results and materials (GBR-015).
User filters by date range or type.
System displays totals: number of incidents, recurrences (reopened), average resolution time and last preventive maintenance (GBR-161).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows users to see asset statistics by branch, floor/area, room, department, category and condition.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Review Assets by Location
User opens Assets by Location.
System displays counts of active assets grouped by location and condition; retired assets are shown separately (GBR-090, GBR-161).
User changes the grouping or filters.
User selects a group to see its asset list (UC-071).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows the Operations Manager to retire an asset that is no longer used.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The asset is Active.
spec.Normal Flow:
Retire/Deactivate Asset
Operations Manager opens the asset and selects Retire.
System checks open incidents, open occurrences, active schedules and pending handovers (GBR-090).
System asks User to confirm the retirement of the asset (MSG33).
Operations Manager enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-012, GBR-005).
System changes the asset lifecycle status from Active to Retired (GBR-009).
System saves the retirement and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Dependencies Exist
Open work or a pending handover exists.
System lists them (MSG34).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The retired asset is excluded from active statistics; its history remains.

spec.Description: Allows the Administrator to declare, update and deactivate warehouses (stock locations) of a branch with their responsible department.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Manage Warehouses
Administrator opens Warehouses.
System lists warehouses with code, name, branch, responsible department and status.
Administrator creates or edits a warehouse (code, name, branch, responsible department, address/description) and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-091, GBR-003, GBR-004, GBR-005).
System saves the warehouse and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Deactivate Warehouse
Administrator selects Deactivate.
System checks balances and open documents (GBR-091); if any exist it lists them (MSG34) and the flow ends.
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the warehouse (MSG33).
System sets the warehouse Inactive.
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Duplicate Code
The code exists in the branch.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Active warehouses can be used in stock documents.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to maintain the material catalog: item code, name, type (amenity, cleaning chemical, linen, spare part, other), base unit and description.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Manage Inventory Items
Storekeeper opens Items.
System lists items with code, name, type, base unit and status.
Storekeeper creates or edits an item and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-092, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the item and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Deactivate Item
Storekeeper selects Deactivate.
System asks User to confirm the deactivation of the item (MSG33).
System sets the item Inactive; it cannot be used in new documents but its balances and history remain (GBR-009).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Base Unit Change After Transactions
The item has stock transactions and the base unit is changed.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-092).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.2_Duplicate Code
The item code exists.
System displays MSG35.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Active items can be requested, received and issued.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to manage units of measurement and the conversion factor of each item's additional units (e.g. 1 box = 24 bottles).
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Manage Units of Measurement
Storekeeper opens Units of Measurement.
System lists units and, per item, the conversions to its base unit.
Storekeeper adds a unit or an item conversion (unit, factor to base unit) and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-093, GBR-003, GBR-005).
System saves the unit/conversion and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Deactivate Conversion
Storekeeper deactivates a conversion.
System sets it Inactive; posted documents keep the factor used (GBR-093).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Conversion
The factor is ≤ 0 or the unit already has a conversion for the item.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-093).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Documents can use the unit; stock is always stored in the base unit.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to set the minimum stock level of an item in a warehouse to trigger low-stock alerts and replenishment.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Configure Minimum Stock Levels
Storekeeper opens Minimum Stock Levels and selects a warehouse.
System lists the warehouse's items with current available quantity and minimum level.
Storekeeper enters or changes the minimum levels (base unit) and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-094, GBR-095, GBR-005).
System saves the minimum levels and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
A minimum level is negative.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Low-stock alerts (UC-128) use the new levels from the next scan.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to prepare a stock receipt (draft) for incoming materials, optionally linked to a replenishment request.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Stock Receipt
Storekeeper opens Stock Receipts and selects Create.
System displays the form: receiving warehouse, source (supplier name or internal), reference document no., linked replenishment (optional), lines (item, unit, expected quantity).
Storekeeper enters the information and selects Save Draft.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-099, GBR-095, GBR-093, GBR-121, GBR-004).
System saves the receipt as Draft (stock is not changed) and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Edit or Cancel Draft
Storekeeper opens a Draft receipt.
Storekeeper edits lines and selects Save, or selects Cancel with a reason (GBR-100, GBR-012).
System saves the draft or changes it to Cancelled; stock is not changed (GBR-096).
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Replenishment Mismatch
The linked replenishment is for another warehouse or does not contain an item.
System displays MSG03.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: A Draft receipt is ready to be verified and posted (UC-080).

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to check the materials actually received against a draft receipt and post it, increasing stock.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The receipt is Draft.
spec.Normal Flow:
Verify and Post Stock Receipt
Storekeeper opens the Draft receipt and selects Verify and Post.
System displays each line with expected quantity and fields for received, rejected (damaged) quantity and reason.
Storekeeper enters the actual quantities and selects Post.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-099, GBR-095, GBR-006, GBR-005).
System changes the receipt from Draft to Posted and creates ledger entries that increase available stock by the accepted quantities (base unit) (GBR-096, GBR-093).
If linked to a replenishment, System updates its received quantity and status (GBR-121).
System saves the receipt, ledger and replenishment and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requesters waiting for these items (material requests with a shortage) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Quantity Difference Without Reason
Received differs from expected and no reason is entered.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-099).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
Step 4.2_Already Posted
The receipt was already posted (double submission).
System does not post it again and shows the posted receipt (MSG28, GBR-006).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: Stock increases by the accepted quantities; the posted receipt cannot be edited (GBR-098).

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to post a stock issue for an approved material request: the issued quantities leave the warehouse and are recorded against the request and its linked work.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The material request is Approved or Partially Issued.
spec.Normal Flow:
Issue Stock
Storekeeper opens the approved request (from UC-097/UC-098) and selects Issue.
System displays each request line with approved, issued and remaining quantity and the available stock of the selected warehouse (GBR-116).
Storekeeper selects the warehouse, enters the quantity to issue per line and the receiver, and selects Post.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-101, GBR-095, GBR-097, GBR-093, GBR-006, GBR-005).
System creates a Posted issue document linked to the request and its linked work, and ledger entries that decrease available stock (GBR-096).
System increases the issued quantity of each request line.
System saves the issue, ledger and request lines and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System returns to the calling use case to update the request status (UC-097 or UC-098).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Insufficient Stock
A quantity exceeds available stock.
System displays MSG16 (GBR-097).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow (Storekeeper may reduce the quantity, i.e. partial fulfillment).
Step 4.2_Exceeds Remaining Approved Quantity
A quantity exceeds the remaining approved quantity.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-101).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Stock and the request's issued quantities are updated in one transaction (GBR-007).

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to receive materials returned by a department (from a return request) and post the return.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
A return request created in UC-090 is Pending Receipt (Draft).
spec.Normal Flow:
Return Materials to Stock
Storekeeper opens the pending return.
System displays the original issue, returned items and declared quantities.
Storekeeper inspects the materials and enters, per line, the quantity accepted as usable and the damaged quantity with reason, then selects Post.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-102, GBR-095, GBR-006, GBR-005).
System changes the return from Draft to Posted and creates ledger entries increasing available stock by the accepted quantities only (GBR-102).
System saves the return and ledger and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requester (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Fewer Items Received Than Declared
The physical quantity is lower than declared.
Storekeeper enters the actual quantity; the difference is recorded with a note and the return is closed with what was received.
Return to step 4 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Return Exceeds Issued Quantity
The cumulative returned quantity would exceed the issued quantity.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-102).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Usable returned materials are back in stock; damaged ones are recorded but not added.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to create a transfer of materials from one warehouse to another (same or different branch) and dispatch it.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Stock Transfer
Storekeeper opens Stock Transfers and selects Create.
System displays the form: source warehouse, destination warehouse, lines (item, unit, quantity), note.
Storekeeper enters the information and selects Save Draft.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-103, GBR-095, GBR-093, GBR-004, GBR-002).
System saves the transfer as Draft and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
When the goods leave, Storekeeper selects Dispatch.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-103, GBR-097, GBR-006, GBR-005).
System changes the transfer from Draft to In Transit, decreasing source stock and recording the in-transit quantity (GBR-103).
System saves the dispatch and ledger and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Storekeeper of the destination warehouse (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 6.1_Cancel Draft
Storekeeper selects Cancel on a Draft transfer.
Storekeeper enters a reason; System sets the transfer Cancelled (no stock effect).
The flow ends.
Step 7.1_Insufficient Source Stock
A line exceeds available stock.
System displays MSG16.
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Dispatched quantities are in transit and not counted in either warehouse's available stock.

spec.Description: Allows the destination Storekeeper to confirm materials received from a transfer, possibly in several batches, and record discrepancies.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The transfer is In Transit or Partially Received; User manages the destination warehouse.
spec.Normal Flow:
Confirm Stock Transfer Receipt
Storekeeper opens the transfer and selects Confirm Receipt.
System displays each line with dispatched and already confirmed quantities.
Storekeeper enters received, damaged and missing quantities per line (with reasons for damaged/missing) and selects Confirm.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-104, GBR-095, GBR-006, GBR-005).
System increases destination stock by the received quantities and records damaged/missing quantities as transfer losses (GBR-104).
System sets the transfer to Received when all dispatched quantities are confirmed, otherwise Partially Received.
System saves the confirmation and ledger and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the source Storekeeper (GBR-010).
System displays the result (MSG08 or MSG18).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Exceeds Outstanding Quantity
Confirmed quantities exceed what is still in transit.
System displays MSG03.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Stock at the destination is updated; every dispatched unit is received, damaged or missing.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to start a stocktake of a warehouse and record the physically counted quantities.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Conduct Stocktake
Storekeeper opens Stocktakes and selects Start Stocktake for a warehouse.
System checks that no other stocktake is open for the warehouse (GBR-105).
System creates the stocktake In Progress with the cutoff time = now and lists all items with balance or minimum level in the warehouse.
Storekeeper enters the counted quantity of each item (base unit) and selects Save; counting can be saved several times.
Storekeeper selects Submit Count.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-105, GBR-095, GBR-005).
System changes the stocktake to Counted.
System saves the counts and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Stocktake Already Open
An open stocktake exists for the warehouse.
System displays MSG03.
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Cancel Stocktake
Storekeeper cancels an In Progress stocktake with a reason.
System sets it Cancelled; no adjustment is created.
The flow ends.
Step 6.1_Items Not Counted
Some items have no counted quantity.
System lists them (MSG03); Storekeeper enters 0 or the count.
Return to step 4 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The counted stocktake is ready for reconciliation (UC-086).

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to compare counted quantities with system quantities at the cutoff and explain each discrepancy.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The stocktake is Counted.
spec.Normal Flow:
Reconcile Stocktake Discrepancies
Storekeeper opens the stocktake and selects Reconcile.
System calculates, per item, the system quantity at the cutoff (posted movements up to the cutoff) and the discrepancy (GBR-105, GBR-106).
Storekeeper enters a cause for each non-zero discrepancy and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-106, GBR-005).
System changes the stocktake to Pending Adjustment.
System saves the reconciliation and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Operations Manager for adjustment approval (UC-087) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_No Discrepancy
All discrepancies are 0.
System changes the stocktake to Reconciled without an adjustment (GBR-106).
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Missing Cause
A discrepancy has no cause.
System displays MSG03.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Discrepancies are explained and wait for the Operations Manager.

spec.Description: Allows the Operations Manager to approve and post stock adjustments, from a reconciled stocktake or for an error correction.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
A stocktake is Pending Adjustment, or an error correction is needed.
spec.Normal Flow:
Adjust Stock Balance
Operations Manager opens the stocktake in Pending Adjustment.
System displays the discrepancies with causes and the resulting balances.
Operations Manager reviews and selects Approve Adjustment with a note.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-107, GBR-097, GBR-013, GBR-006, GBR-005).
System creates a Posted adjustment document whose lines equal the discrepancies and changes the stocktake to Reconciled (GBR-107).
System saves the adjustment, ledger and stocktake and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Error-Correction Adjustment
Operations Manager selects New Adjustment without a stocktake.
Operations Manager selects warehouse, items, signed quantities and the correction reason (GBR-012).
Return to step 4 of the normal flow.
Step 3.1_Return Stocktake for Recount
Causes are not convincing.
Operations Manager selects Return with a reason; System sets the stocktake back to Counted and notifies the Storekeeper (MSG20).
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Negative Stock
The adjustment would make stock negative.
System displays MSG16.
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: Stock balances equal the counted quantities; the adjustment is traceable to its stocktake.

spec.Description: Allows the Operations Manager to reverse a posted stock document that was wrong, by creating an offsetting document while keeping the original.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The document is Posted and is a receipt, issue, return or adjustment.
spec.Normal Flow:
Reverse Stock Transaction
Operations Manager opens the posted document and selects Reverse.
System checks that it has not been reversed, has no dependent later documents and that reversal keeps stock non-negative (GBR-108).
System asks User to confirm the reversal of the document (MSG33).
Operations Manager enters the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-108, GBR-012, GBR-006, GBR-005).
System creates a Posted reversal document with opposite quantities, marks the original as Reversed, and for an issue reduces the request's issued quantity (GBR-108).
System saves the reversal and ledger and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Reversal Not Allowed
The document was already reversed, has dependent documents or would cause negative stock.
System displays the reason (MSG34 or MSG16).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The ledger shows both the original and the reversal (GBR-098).

UC-089.name: View Stock Balance and Movement Ledger

spec.Description: Allows users to look up current stock and the movement ledger by warehouse, item and period.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
View Stock Balance and Movement Ledger
User opens Stock Balance.
System displays, per warehouse and item, available quantity, in-transit quantity and minimum level, highlighting items below minimum (GBR-109).
User filters by warehouse, item, type or below-minimum flag, or selects an item to view its ledger.
System displays the posted movements in the period (receipts, issues, returns, transfers, adjustments, reversals) with opening and closing balances (GBR-109, GBR-015).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Primary Actors: Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows a user who received materials to request returning unused or excess quantities to the warehouse.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
User (or User's department) received the materials through a posted issue.
spec.Normal Flow:
Return Unused Materials
User opens the posted issue (from the material request) and selects Return Materials.
System displays the issued lines with quantity issued and already returned.
User enters the quantities to return and the reason and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-102, GBR-095).
System creates a return request (stock document Draft – Pending Receipt); stock is not changed (GBR-096).
System saves the return request and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Storekeeper of the warehouse (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Withdraw Return
The return is still Pending Receipt and User selects Withdraw.
System sets it Cancelled.
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Quantity Too High
The quantity exceeds what can still be returned.
System displays MSG03.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The Storekeeper receives and posts the return in UC-082.

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows an operational user to request materials from inventory, stating items, quantities, purpose, receiving department/location and needed-by time.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Material Request
User opens Material Requests and selects Create.
System displays the form: receiving department/location, purpose, needed-by time, linked work (optional), lines (item, unit, quantity).
User enters the information and selects Submit (or Save Draft).
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-110, GBR-095, GBR-093, GBR-004, GBR-014).
System creates the request with status Pending Approval and determines the approver (GBR-111).
System saves the request and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the approver (UC-125) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Save Draft
User selects Save Draft.
System saves the request as Draft without notifying anyone; it can be edited and submitted later (UC-093).
The flow ends.
Step 3.2_Link to Work
User selects the work record the materials are for.
System continues with UC-092 for the selection.
Return to step 4 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The request waits for review and approval.

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows the requester to link a material request to the cleaning task, incident, maintenance occurrence or operational task that will use the materials.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
User is the creator of the request.
The request is not Cancelled or Rejected.
spec.Normal Flow:
Link Material Request to Work
User opens the request and selects Link to Work.
System lists open work records of the same branch that User can view.
User selects the record and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-118, GBR-005).
System saves the link and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The work record is closed, cancelled or in another branch.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Issued materials and their usage are traceable to the work record.

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows the creator to edit, resubmit or cancel a material request before materials are issued.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
User is the creator of the request.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update/Cancel Material Request
User opens the request and selects Edit.
System displays the request with the current row version and its review history.
User changes lines, purpose or needed-by time and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-112, GBR-110, GBR-095, GBR-005).
System saves the changes; a Draft or Needs Information request becomes Pending Approval; an Approved request without issues returns to Pending Approval and its approved quantities are cleared (GBR-112).
System saves the request with before/after values and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the approver (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Cancel Request
User selects Cancel.
System checks that nothing has been issued (GBR-113).
System asks User to confirm the cancellation of the request (MSG33).
User enters the reason (GBR-012).
System changes the request to Cancelled.
System saves the cancellation and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the approver if it had been submitted (GBR-010).
The flow ends.
Step 4.1_Not Editable
The request is Partially Issued, Fully Issued, Rejected, Cancelled or Remainder Closed.
System displays MSG24.
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The approval always refers to the latest content; history of changes is kept.

spec.Description: Allows the approver to review a material request: purpose, quantities, linked work, recent consumption and current stock.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The request is Pending Approval and User is its approver (GBR-111).
spec.Normal Flow:
Review Material Request
Approver opens the request from the notification or Pending Approvals.
System displays the lines, purpose, linked work, the requester's recent requests for the same items and the available stock (read-only, not reserved) (GBR-114).
Approver decides to approve/reject (UC-095) or to ask for more information.
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Request More Information
The request lacks justification.
Approver selects Need Information and enters the question (GBR-012).
System changes the request from Pending Approval to Needs Information (GBR-114).
System saves the review and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requester (GBR-010).
System displays MSG20; the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The request is decided in UC-095 or returned to the requester.

spec.Description: Allows the approver to approve a material request (possibly with reduced quantities), reject it, or close the unissued remainder of a partially issued request.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
User is the request's approver (GBR-111).
spec.Normal Flow:
Approve/Reject Material Request
Approver opens the Pending Approval request and selects Decide.
System displays each line with requested quantity and an approved quantity field (default = requested).
Approver enters the approved quantities and selects Approve.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-115, GBR-013, GBR-005).
System changes the request from Pending Approval to Approved and stores the approved quantities (GBR-115).
System saves the decision and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requester and the Storekeeper (UC-125) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Close Remainder
The request is Partially Issued and the remainder will not be issued.
Approver selects Close Remainder and enters the reason (GBR-117).
System changes the request to Remainder Closed; issued quantities are unchanged.
System saves the closure and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requester and the Storekeeper (GBR-010).
The flow ends.
Step 3.1_Reject
Approver selects Reject.
Approver enters the reason (GBR-012).
System changes the request to Rejected.
System saves the decision and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requester (GBR-010).
System displays MSG19; the flow ends.
Step 4.1_All Quantities Zero
Every approved quantity is 0.
System treats the decision as a rejection and asks for a reason (GBR-115).
Continue at Step 3.1.
Step 4.2_Approver Is Requester
The approver created the request.
System displays MSG22 (GBR-013).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: Only approved quantities can be issued.

spec.Description: Allows users to check whether approved materials can be issued: available stock per warehouse versus remaining approved quantity.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The request is Approved or Partially Issued, or is being reviewed by its approver.
spec.Normal Flow:
Check Material Availability
User opens the request and selects Check Availability.
System displays, per line, remaining approved quantity, available stock per warehouse in the branch, in-transit quantity and the fulfillable quantity (GBR-116).
User selects a warehouse to see the result for that warehouse.
System highlights lines that cannot be fully issued and suggests partial fulfillment (UC-098) or replenishment (UC-100).
spec.Alternative Flows: None.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed; nothing is reserved (GBR-114).

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to issue all remaining approved materials of a request, using the stock issue process of UC-081.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The request is Approved or Partially Issued.
spec.Normal Flow:
Issue Approved Materials
Storekeeper opens Requests to Fulfil and selects the request.
System displays the remaining approved quantities and availability (UC-096).
Storekeeper selects Issue Remaining.
System performs the stock issue for all remaining quantities (UC-081) (GBR-101, GBR-097).
System changes the request to Fully Issued (GBR-116).
System saves the request status together with the issue and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requester that materials are ready for pickup (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Not Enough Stock
Some remaining quantity is not available.
System displays MSG16 and offers partial fulfillment (UC-098) and replenishment (UC-100).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The request is Fully Issued; stock is reduced.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to issue part of an approved request when stock is short, keeping the remainder open for later issues.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The request is Approved or Partially Issued.
spec.Normal Flow:
Manage Partial Material Fulfillment
Storekeeper opens the request and selects Partial Issue.
System displays remaining approved quantity and fulfillable quantity per line (GBR-116).
Storekeeper enters the quantities to issue now (less than or equal to the fulfillable quantity) and selects Issue.
System performs the stock issue (UC-081) (GBR-101).
System changes the request to Partially Issued while a remainder exists, or Fully Issued when nothing remains (GBR-116).
System saves the request status together with the issue and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the requester with issued and remaining quantities (GBR-010).
System displays the result (MSG18).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 7.1_Create Replenishment for Shortage
Stock will not cover the remainder.
System offers to create a replenishment request for the shortage (UC-100).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The remainder stays open until issued or closed by the approver (UC-095).

spec.Primary Actors: Administrator, Operations Manager, Housekeeping Supervisor, Housekeeping Staff, Maintenance Lead, Maintenance Staff, Storekeeper, Department Head
spec.Description: Allows users to follow the full lifecycle of material requests: creation, review, approval, issues, returns, cancellation or closure.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Track Material Request History
User opens the Material Request History screen.
System displays requests visible to the user (GBR-119) with status, requester, approver and issued/approved quantities, sorted by creation time (newest first) (GBR-015).
User filters by status, department, requester, item and date range or searches by keyword.
System refreshes the list with matching records in the user's scope (GBR-015).
User selects a request.
System displays its timeline: submissions, reviews, decisions with approved quantities, issue and return documents, linked work, and the remaining quantity (GBR-008).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: No data is changed.

spec.Description: Allows the Storekeeper to request replenishment of materials that are below minimum stock or short for approved requests.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Replenishment Request
Storekeeper opens Replenishment and selects Create.
System proposes lines for items below minimum in the warehouse and for unfulfilled approved quantities, with suggested quantity (GBR-120).
Storekeeper adjusts lines (item, unit, quantity), enters supplier name and expected date (optional) and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-120, GBR-095, GBR-093, GBR-004).
System creates the replenishment request with status Requested.
System saves the replenishment request and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Operations Manager for information (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Shortage Already Requested
An open replenishment already covers the same item and shortage.
System shows the existing request (MSG03, GBR-120).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Incoming goods are received with UC-079/UC-080 linked to this request. Purchasing approval is outside V1 scope (GBR-017).

spec.Description: Allows users to track replenishment requests: requested, received and remaining quantities, and which material requests are still waiting.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Track Material Replenishment
User opens the Replenishment Tracking screen.
System displays replenishment requests with status, requested, received and remaining quantities, sorted by expected date (GBR-015).
User filters by status, warehouse, item, supplier and date range or searches by keyword.
System refreshes the list with matching records in the user's scope (GBR-015).
User selects a request.
System displays its lines, linked posted receipts, and the material requests waiting for these items (GBR-121).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
System displays an empty list with the applied filters (MSG10).
User changes the filters or the flow ends.
Step 5.1_Close Remaining Quantity
The remaining quantity will not arrive and Storekeeper selects Close.
Storekeeper enters the reason (GBR-122).
System changes the request to Closed.
System saves the closure and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: Status changes only through posted receipts or closure.

spec.Description: Allows the Department Head to create an ad-hoc or recurring operational task with category, location, expected outcome and completion criteria.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Create Operational Task
Department Head opens Tasks and selects Create.
System displays the form: title, category, department, location (optional), description, expected outcome, completion criteria (mandatory flag), priority, planned start, deadline, source (internal request, optional).
Department Head enters the information and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-123, GBR-125, GBR-003, GBR-004, GBR-014).
System creates the task with status Pending Assignment.
System saves the task and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Recurring Task
Department Head selects Repeat.
System displays recurrence fields: rule (daily, weekly on days, monthly on day), default assignee, end date (GBR-124).
Department Head enters them and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-124, GBR-126).
System creates an Active task series; occurrences are generated automatically before each due date (GBR-124).
Return to step 6 of the normal flow.
Step 3.2_Assign Now
Department Head selects Save and Assign.
System continues with UC-104 after Step 6.
Step 4.1_Specialised Process Applies
The need is cleaning, an incident or materials.
System advises to use UC-028, UC-049 or UC-091 (MSG03, GBR-123).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The task (or series) exists and waits for assignment.

spec.Description: Allows the Department Head to set or change a task's priority, planned start, deadline and expected duration, or to cancel a task that is no longer needed.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is not Closed or Cancelled.
spec.Normal Flow:
Set Task Priority and Deadline
Department Head opens the task and selects Plan.
System displays priority, planned start, deadline, expected duration and the deadline history.
Department Head changes the values (with a reason when the task is already assigned) and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-125, GBR-014, GBR-005).
System saves the planning values keeping the previous deadline and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assignee, if any (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Cancel Task
Department Head selects Cancel Task.
System checks that no work time has been recorded (GBR-128).
System asks User to confirm the cancellation of the task (MSG33).
Department Head enters the reason (GBR-012).
System changes the task to Cancelled.
System saves the cancellation and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assignee, if any (GBR-010).
The flow ends.
Step 3.2_Deactivate Task Series
The task belongs to a series and Department Head selects Stop Series.
System sets the series Inactive; already generated tasks remain (GBR-124).
Return to step 5 of the normal flow.
Step 4.1_Reason Missing
The deadline of an assigned task changes without reason.
System displays MSG03 (GBR-125).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The task plan is updated and visible to the assignee.

spec.Description: Allows the Department Head to assign a task to an executor or move it to another executor, considering workload.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is Pending Assignment, Assigned, Accepted, In Progress or Paused.
spec.Normal Flow:
Assign/Reassign Task
Department Head opens the task and selects Assign.
System lists eligible executors of the department with their open tasks and time logged today (GBR-126).
Department Head selects the executor (and a reason when reassigning) and selects Assign.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-126, GBR-127, GBR-005).
System closes the previous assignee's open work interval, if any, sets the new assignee and changes the task to Assigned (GBR-127, GBR-138).
System saves the assignment with previous and new assignee and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the new (and previous) assignee (UC-124) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
The executor is inactive, lacks an executor role or is outside the department/branch.
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The assignee must accept the task (UC-107).

spec.Description: Allows the Department Head to review a submitted task result and close it, or return it for further work.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is Pending Verification.
spec.Normal Flow:
Review and Verify Task Completion
Department Head opens the task from Pending Verification.
System displays completion criteria results, notes, evidence and time spent.
Department Head selects Accept and enters a verification note.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-133, GBR-013, GBR-005).
System changes the task from Pending Verification to Closed.
System saves the verification and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assignee (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Return for More Work
The result is not acceptable.
Department Head selects Return and enters what must be fixed (GBR-012).
System changes the task from Pending Verification to Accepted for the same assignee (GBR-133).
System saves the return and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assignee (GBR-010).
System displays MSG20; the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The task is Closed, or returned to the assignee.

spec.Description: Allows the Department Head to reopen a closed task whose result turns out to be unsatisfactory.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is Closed.
spec.Normal Flow:
Reopen Assigned Task
Department Head opens the closed task and selects Reopen.
System displays the task result and history.
Department Head enters the reason, remediation instructions and the assignee (same or new) and selects Reopen.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-134, GBR-126, GBR-012).
System starts a new cycle: the task changes from Closed to Assigned; previous results are kept.
System saves the reopening and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the assignee (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Data
System highlights the invalid fields and shows the reason (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The task must be accepted again by the assignee.

spec.Description: Allows the assigned executor to accept a task (confirming responsibility) or decline it with a reason.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is Assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Accept Assigned Task
Executor opens the task from My Work or the notification.
System displays the task details, criteria, priority and deadline.
Executor selects Accept.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-129, GBR-005).
System changes the task from Assigned to Accepted.
System saves the acceptance and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 3.1_Decline Task
Executor cannot do the task.
Executor selects Decline and enters the reason (GBR-129).
System changes the task to Pending Assignment and removes the assignee.
System saves the decline and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Department Head (GBR-010).
System displays MSG19; the flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The task is Accepted and can be started.

spec.Description: Allows the assignee to start an accepted task; the system starts recording working time.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is Accepted and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Start Assigned Task
Executor opens the task and selects Start.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-130, GBR-136, GBR-137, GBR-005).
System changes the task from Accepted to In Progress, sets the actual start (first time) and opens a work interval (GBR-138).
System saves the task and interval and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 2.1_Workday Not Started or Busy
User has no Working workday or another open work interval.
System displays MSG30 or MSG31.
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: The task is In Progress.

spec.Description: Allows the assignee to record progress, results of completion criteria, notes and evidence while working.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is In Progress or Paused and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Update Task Progress
Executor opens the task and selects Update Progress.
System displays progress, completion criteria and notes.
Executor enters progress, criterion results, notes and files and selects Save.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-050, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System saves the progress and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Invalid Attachment
A file violates the policy.
System displays MSG23.
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: Progress is updated; reaching 100% does not complete the task.

spec.Description: Allows the assignee to pause an in-progress task with a reason and resume it later; paused time is not counted as work time.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is In Progress or Paused and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Pause/Resume Task
Executor opens the In Progress task and selects Pause.
System displays pause reasons (reference data) and a note field.
Executor selects the reason and confirms.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-131, GBR-005).
System changes the task to Paused and closes the work interval (GBR-138).
System saves the pause and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System displays a success message (MSG08).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 1.1_Resume
The task is Paused and Executor selects Resume.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-130, GBR-136, GBR-137).
System changes the task to In Progress and opens a new work interval.
System saves the resume and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
The flow ends.
spec.Postconditions: Pause periods are visible in the task timeline and excluded from effort (GBR-140).

spec.Description: Allows the assignee to submit a task as finished with results, evidence and handover notes, for verification.
spec.Preconditions:
User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
The task is In Progress and assigned to User.
spec.Normal Flow:
Complete Assigned Task
Executor opens the task and selects Complete.
System displays the completion criteria, result note, evidence and handover note fields.
Executor enters the results and selects Submit.
System validates the input and business conditions (GBR-132, GBR-016, GBR-005).
System changes the task from In Progress to Pending Verification, sets the actual end and closes the work interval (GBR-138).
System saves the results and records the audit log in the same transaction (GBR-007, GBR-008).
System sends an in-app notification to the Department Head for verification (UC-105) (GBR-010).
System displays a success message (MSG09).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_Mandatory Criteria Missing
A mandatory criterion has no result.
System lists them (MSG03).
Return to step 3 of the normal flow.
spec.Postconditions: The task waits for verification.

UC-113.name: Review Task Workload and Time Logs

spec.Description: Allows the Department Head and Operations Manager to review task workload and time logs by employee, status, priority and deadline.
spec.Preconditions: User has logged in and has permission for this function (GBR-001, GBR-002).
spec.Normal Flow:
Review Task Workload and Time Logs
User opens the Workload screen.
System displays per employee: open tasks, overdue tasks, tasks closed in the period, total effort from closed work intervals and provisional open time (GBR-140, GBR-135), sorted by employee name (GBR-015).
User filters by department, employee, status, priority, deadline and period or searches by keyword.
System refreshes the list with matching records in the user's scope (GBR-015).
User selects an employee.
System displays the employee's tasks and time log for the period; shift time is shown separately from task time (GBR-140).
spec.Alternative Flows:
Step 4.1_No Matching Records
No record matches the filters.
